edges.reason: constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting privileged control
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from address of transferFrom
transferFrom authorizes msg.sender against allowance and is the caller of record
approve writes allowance for msg.sender
delegate is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
_mints is gated by owner or a hardcoded backdoor address
init is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
batchSend is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
setTradeAddress is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
transfer returns the result of transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
transferFrom calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating state
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to]
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] when caller is not _from
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from]
balanceOf updates use unchecked -= and += inherited from the raw ERC20 logic
ensure calls condition(_from, _value) when no allowlist bypass applies
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address
ensure reads owner for the allowlist bypass
ensure reads canSale[_from] for the allowlist bypass
ensure reads tradeAddress for the allowlist bypass
ensure compares _from against the constant UNI router address
ensure stores the pairFor result in the local _UNI
pairFor returns the derived pair into local _UNI
ensure's require(condition(...)) reverts transferFrom for non-allowlisted senders, gating execution
condition reads _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale sale configuration
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against the sale limit
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with an arbitrary scaled value
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, granting a permanent transfer allowlist bypass
_mints contains the unchecked balance overwrite operation
init sets _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum controlling the condition gate
batchSend decrements msg.sender balance and increments each recipient balance without SafeMath
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection
the computed total feeds the unchecked batch arithmetic operation
batchSend executes unchecked multiplication and balance additions
batchSend uses loop counter i
batchSend extracts each recipient into the local _to
setTradeAddress writes tradeAddress, controlling the ensure allowlist bypass
constructor sets owner to the deployer
constructor mints totalSupply to msg.sender balanceOf
constructor grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router address
delegate passes attacker-controlled address and calldata into the delegatecall
delegatecall executes external contract code as a callback inside this contract's context
require(msg.sender == owner) is the only guard protecting the delegatecall
_from parameter flows into transferFrom balance and allowance logic
_to parameter flows into transferFrom recipient balance logic
_value parameter flows into transferFrom amount checks and arithmetic
_value parameter is compared against min/max sale limits in condition
_tos parameter is iterated by batchSend
addr parameter is written into tradeAddress
a and b parameters are forwarded to the delegatecall
spender parameter is the target of the balance overwrite in _mints
addedValue parameter is scaled and assigned to balanceOf in _mints
init parameters configure the sale limits and count
_to parameter is forwarded from transfer into transferFrom

normalization_plan.reason: _from only feeds transferFrom/ensure balance and allowance handling and has no independent semantics
_to is the recipient argument of transferFrom and transfer and is fully captured by that function
_value is the amount argument driving transferFrom and condition checks
spender exists only as the target address of the _mints balance overwrite
addedValue is only used to compute the arbitrary balance in _mints
saleNum, token and maxToken only configure the owner-only init function
_tos is the recipient list iterated exclusively by batchSend
addr is only assigned to tradeAddress inside setTradeAddress
a and b are the delegatecall target and payload and belong to the delegate function
_UNI is a transient local in ensure holding the pairFor result
total is a transient local computed in batchSend before the balance updates
i is the batchSend loop counter with no independent meaning
_to is the per-iteration recipient extracted inside batchSend
